lines.en: Opening the menu hid the character.

lines.ko: 전에는 글자 뒤에 불투명한 띠를 깔았습니다.
lines.en: Before, I laid opaque bars behind the text.
lines.art: a heavy curtain drawn halfway across a framed portrait

lines.ko: 이제는 뒤의 장면을 흐리게만 보여 줍니다.
lines.en: Now the scene behind just shows through, blurred.
The character stays visible beside the menu, just blurred.
lines.art: a person's silhouette seen through frosted glass beside an open notebook

lines.ko: 닫기 한 번이면 대화 화면으로 돌아옵니다.
lines.en: One tap on Close takes you back to the conversation.
enLines: takes you back to the conversation.

lines.ko: 처음엔 흐림 위에 짙은 색도 깔았습니다.
lines.en: At first, I added a dark color on top of the blur.
enLines: At first, I added a dark color

lines.ko: 그런데 그 색이 배경을 또 가렸습니다.
lines.en: But that color covered the background again.

lines.ko: 그래서 색을 빼고 흐림을 약하게 했습니다.
lines.en: So I removed the color and made the blur lighter.

lines.ko: 다음은 인물 뒤에 보일 배경 그림입니다.
lines.en: Next is the background art behind the character.
lines.art: an artist's easel holding an unfinished sketch of an empty room behind a seated figure

lines.en: Now the character shows even behind the menu.

failCard.title: 배경이 또 가려졌다
failCard.beforeEn: A dark color covered the background
failCard.afterEn: A light blur that fades out slowly
